fib: ______ is a special kind of thinking in which inferences are drawn from judgments called premises to other judgments called conclusions.
Reasoning
Reasoning is a special kind of thinking in which inferences are drawn from judgments called premises to other judgments called conclusions.
______ is the knowledge a person finds within a moment of insight without going through a conscious process of reasoning.
Intuitive knowledge
Intuitive knowledge is the knowledge a person finds within a moment of insight without going through a conscious process of reasoning.
______ is the discipline at the intersection of ethics and epistemology, that studies the epistemic status and relations of moral judgements and principles, (Audi 508).
Moral epistemology
Moral epistemology is the discipline at the intersection of ethics and epistemology, that studies the epistemic status and relations of moral judgements and principles, (Audi 508).
______ can be defined as the state of awareness of a given fact or information.

Knowledge can be defined as the state of awareness of a given fact or information.

Feminist epistemology
Feminist epistemology is a recent trend in the analysis of knowledge.

The Renaissance is the age of re- awakening of the human spirit which had hitherto laid dormant during the medieval period.
______ is a recent approach to epistemology that provides an all-inclusive explanatory model for our cognitive process.

Integrative Epistemology is a recent approach to epistemology that provides an all-inclusive explanatory model for our cognitive process.

Justification
